title: Retail & CPG Store Ops + Merchandising Configuration

org_configured.description: True once Retail & CPG Store Ops + Merchandising organization thresholds and connectors are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or department name.

zero_scan_days_threshold.description: Days without POS scans for positive book on-hand before flagging phantom inventory.

min_book_qty_for_phantom.description: Minimum perpetual book qty required to trigger zero-scan investigation.

high_shrink_usd_threshold.description: Physical count variance threshold in USD triggering EAS/receiving audit.

min_acceptable_promo_roi.description: Minimum incremental net gross margin ROI ratio to classify campaign as scalable.

target_otif_pct.description: Contractual vendor On-Time In-Full SLA threshold percentage.

in_full_tolerance_pct.description: Minimum received-vs-ordered fill rate required for In-Full pass.

on_time_grace_minutes.description: Dock arrival grace window past appointment time.
